items.question: Does Astro Phosphor require a backend server or database?
items.answer: No. Every page, OS style, project showcase, MDX journal post, design specimen, and offline arcade game compiles to 100% static files in dist/.

items.question: How do I switch between the 5 retro desktop OS styles and 20 presets?
items.answer: Click the OS button in the top menu bar or bottom dock, open Menu → System, visit /design-system, or append ?os=rainbow|phosphor|coffee|cli|pixel to any URL.

items.question: How do I add a new OS style or replace the desk monitor photo?
items.answer: Use the built-in Agent Skills in .agents/skills/add-os-style/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/room-backdrop/SKILL.md, backed by AGENTS.md and docs/DESIGN.md.
